name: secret-guard
in_sample: The benign rate is in-sample: the reads-as-words gate, the URL placeholder list and the tightened credential-word label were tuned on this same corpus after a first run held 151 paragraphs and denied 3. The synthetic set is drawn in the rules' own shapes, so its coverage is by construction. Neither number is an estimate for secrets or text in the wild; card X14's corpus, unseen by the tuning, is.
limits: a zero-width space inside a key (AKIA, U+200B, then the rest) is not found
a key split across a line break is not found
a key encoded in base64 is not recognised as its kind; at most the high-entropy rule holds a long encoded run at REVIEW
a key in full-width characters (U+FF21 and the like) is not found
a key split between a JSON key and its value is not found
a bare 9-digit US SSN with no cue word (ssn, social security) is not found
a value of 64 hexadecimal digits written after sha256: is exempt as a content hash, so a hexadecimal secret so prefixed passes
only the item's content is scanned; provenance.ref and other fields are not
English-centred patterns: a cue word in another language is not a cue
